anywhere.description: If `true`, the IP address will be ignored.

forever.description: If `true`, no time limit will be applied.

browser.description:
Browser cache duration (works for status codes `200`, `201`, `204`, `206`, `301`, `302`, `303`, `304`, `307`, `308`).
Pattern: `^(\d+)[smhd]$`.

force.description: If `true`, caching headers will be ignored.

end_iso8601.description: Certificate validity end date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

start_iso8601.description: Certificate validity start date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

end_iso8601.description: Certificate validity end date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

start_iso8601.description: Certificate validity start date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

end_iso8601.description: Certificate validity end date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

issuer_CN.description: Issuer Common Name of the certificate from the chain.

serial.description: Serial Number of the certificate from the chain.

start_iso8601.description: Certificate validity start date/time in the `ISO8601` format.

subject_CN.description: Subject Common Name of the certificate from the chain.
subject_CN.example: GlobalSign GCC R3 DV TLS CA 2020

cdn_domain.description: CDN domain of the created HTTP resource (set when `status` is `accept`).

description.example: Key incorrect or not found ( origin )

resource_id.description: Created HTTP resource identifier (set when `status` is `accept`).

task_id.description: Configuration change task identifier (set when `status` is `accept`).

data.description:
Certificate information when `status` is `0`.
If `details` is `true`, contains `chain_info`.

domains.description: List of domains for a wildcard certificate.

end.description: End of interval in the `ISO 8601-1:2019` format.

start.description: Start of interval in the `ISO 8601-1:2019` format.

IPv4_subnet.description: The Internet Protocol version 4 subnet of the node.

IPv6_subnet.description: The Internet Protocol version 6 subnet of the node.

backup.description: Indicates whether the origin is a backup.

max_fails.description: Number of failed attempts for load balancing.

port.description:
Origin port.
Default: `80` (if `origin.https` is `false`) or `443` (if `origin.https` is `true`).

active.description: Indicates whether the resource is active.

allowed_http_methods.description:
List of allowed HTTP methods.
`GET`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS` are always allowed.

certificate.description: Identifier of the SSL certificate to bind to the resource.

http2https.description: If `true`, HTTP will be automatically redirected to HTTPS during distribution.

https_only.description: If `true`, only HTTPS will be used during distribution.

ioss.description: Indicates whether image optimization and modification is enabled.

limitations.description: Distribution restrictions by geography, IP, Referer, or UserAgent.

locations.description:
Rules for specific request paths.
Key: path pattern (e.g., `/images`, `/video/*`).
Value: location-specific configuration.

modern_tls_only.description: If `true`, only modern TLS versions will be used.

names.description: Canonical Names (CNAMEs) for the CDN domain.

slice_size_megabytes.description: Slice size in MB (only when `tuning` is `large`).

strong_ssl_ciphers.description: If `true`, strong SSL ciphers will be used (requires `modern_tls_only` to be `true`).

url.description: URL of an external authorization script.

expose.description: Headers accessible to the top-level API (Expose Headers). Default allowed: `Cache-Control`, `Content-Language`, `Content-Type`, `Expires`, `Last-Modified`, `Pragma`.

args_blacklist.description: List of query string parameters to ignore when caching (requires `cache.consider_args` to be `true`).

args_whitelist.description: List of query string parameters to consider when caching (requires `cache.consider_args` to be `true`).

consider_args.description: If `true`, query string will be considered when caching.

consider_cookies.description: If `true`, cookies will be considered when caching.

cookies_blacklist.description: List of cookies to ignore when caching (requires `cache.consider_cookies` to be `true`).

cookies_whitelist.description: List of cookies to consider when caching (requires `cache.consider_cookies` to be `true`).

disable.description: If `true`, content will not be cached.

stale_conditions.description: List of conditions for serving stale cached content (requires `use_stale` to be `true`).

use_stale.description: Indicates whether serving stale cached content is enabled when the origin is unavailable.

brotli.description: Indicates whether to use Brotli compression.

gzip.description: Indicates whether to use Gzip compression.

hide_in_response.description: List of headers from the origin that CDN servers hide in the response.

request.description:
Headers to add to origin requests.
Key: header name, Value: header value.
Example: `{"X-Custom-Header": "custom-value", "X-Another-Header": "another-value"}`.

response.description:
Headers to add to user responses.
Key: header name, Value: header value.
Example: `{"X-Custom-Header": "custom-value", "X-Another-Header": "another-value"}`.

allowed_http_methods.description: List of allowed HTTP methods. `GET`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS` are always allowed.

ioss.description: Indicates whether image optimization is enabled.

order.description: Order for regular expression checking (only for locations with regular expression).

aws.description: AWS authorization parameters for origin requests.

forward_host_header.description:
Indicates whether to send the `Host` header from the CDN request to the origin.
Cannot be set together with `origin.hostname`.

hostname.description:
Host header when accessing the origin.
Cannot be set together with `origin.forward_host_header`.

https.description: Indicates whether to use HTTPS when accessing the origin.

s3_bucket.description: Allowed bucket when using a common Simple Storage Service (S3) domain as the origin.

servers.description:
Origin servers description.
Key: domain/ip, Value: origin parameters.

sni_hostname.description:
Allows overriding the server name used for the origin certificate verification and SNI.
(requires `origin.https` to be `true`).

ssl_verify.description: Indicates whether to verify the origin certificate (requires `origin.https` to be `true`).

url.description: Absolute redirect URL (only for `301`, `302`, `303`, `307`, `308` status codes).

rate.description: Success rates for each path (order matches paths order).

private_key.description: New private key text in `PEM` format (optional).
